purpose: Separate legal/entitlement authority from provider-specific live quote mechanics. A provider adapter can prove only technical B/D; it can never self-authorize A/C.
hard_invariants: Authority status MUST equal PROVEN before any live provider call.
Authority provider MUST have an IMPLEMENTED adapter.
Adapter MUST NOT infer entitlement, price-plan eligibility, jurisdiction eligibility, or SIP lineage from payload shape.
bid <= ask; bid, ask and last > 0.
Independent quote and trade event timestamps are mandatory.
Weekend/off-RTH cannot produce a fresh strict G9 PASS.
No order, preview, replace, cancel, or execution endpoint may be called.
